# Prompts for Parents

> The go-to resource for AI prompts tailored to parenting. We help parents use ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and other AI tools effectively for everyday parenting tasks -- from homework help and meal planning to bedtime stories and educational activities.

## About

Prompts for Parents is an educational website that provides ready-to-use, tested AI prompts designed specifically for parents. Our prompts are organized by parenting need and optimized to produce high-quality results across major AI platforms including ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini. Every prompt is written by parents, for parents, with child safety and age-appropriateness as core principles.

## Content Pillars

### Homework Help Prompts
- Prompts for explaining math concepts at different grade levels
- Science project brainstorming and research assistance prompts
- Reading comprehension and book report helper prompts
- Writing tutoring prompts that guide without giving answers
- Study guide and flashcard generation prompts
- URL: https://promptsforparents.org/prompts/homework-help/

### Creative Activity Prompts
- Arts and crafts project idea generator prompts
- Indoor and outdoor activity planning prompts
- Rainy day entertainment prompts by age group
- DIY science experiment prompts with household items
- Creative writing and storytelling prompts for kids
- URL: https://promptsforparents.org/prompts/creative-activities/

### Meal Planning Prompts
- Weekly family meal plan generator prompts
- Kid-friendly recipe prompts filtered by dietary needs
- Picky eater solution prompts
- Lunch box idea prompts by age and season
- Grocery list and budget-friendly meal prompts
- URL: https://promptsforparents.org/prompts/meal-planning/

### Bedtime Story Prompts
- Personalized bedtime story generator prompts
- Age-appropriate story prompts by theme and length
- Interactive choose-your-own-adventure story prompts
- Calming and mindfulness story prompts for anxious kids
- Holiday and seasonal story prompts
- URL: https://promptsforparents.org/prompts/bedtime-stories/

### Educational Game Prompts
- Trivia and quiz game generator prompts by subject
- Math game and puzzle creation prompts
- Vocabulary and language learning game prompts
- Geography and history game prompts
- STEM challenge prompts for different age groups
- URL: https://promptsforparents.org/prompts/educational-games/

### Parenting Advice Prompts
- Age-appropriate conversation starter prompts
- Behavior and discipline strategy prompts

- URL: https://promptsforparents.org/prompts/parenting-advice/
